title: Rectangular beam
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single closed loop made up of fourteen lines. The first line begins at the coordinates (0.0, 0.007) and ends at (0.0, 0.0708). The second line starts at (0.0, 0.0708) and ends at (0.0, 0.0778). The third line runs from (0.0, 0.0778) to (0.2528, 0.0778), and the fourth line goes from (0.2528, 0.0778) to (0.2528, 0.0708). The fifth line extends from (0.2528, 0.0708) to (0.4972, 0.0708), followed by the sixth line from (0.4972, 0.0708) to (0.4972, 0.0778). The seventh line moves from (0.4972, 0.0778) to (0.75, 0.0778), and the eighth line travels from (0.75, 0.0778) to (0.75, 0.0708). The ninth line runs from (0.75, 0.0708) to (0.75, 0.007), and the tenth line goes from (0.75, 0.007) to (0.4972, 0.007). The eleventh line starts at (0.4972, 0.007) and ends at (0.4972, 0.0), while the twelfth line runs from (0.4972, 0.0) to (0.2528, 0.0). The thirteenth line extends from (0.2528, 0.0) to (0.2528, 0.007), and the fourteenth line completes the loop from (0.2528, 0.007) back to (0.0, 0.007). After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch. Then, transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.007 units in the direction of the normal, ensuring not to extrude in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body with this extrusion. The final dimensions of the rectangular beam are a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.07783613445378151 units, and a height of 0.007011554621848738 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = (
    r
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0708)  # line_1
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0778)  # line_2
    .lineTo(0.2528, 0.0778)  # line_3
    .lineTo(0.2528, 0.0708)  # line_4
    .lineTo(0.4972, 0.0708)  # line_5
    .lineTo(0.4972, 0.0778)  # line_6
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0778)  # line_7
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0708)  # line_8
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.007)  # line_9
    .lineTo(0.4972, 0.007)  # line_10
    .lineTo(0.4972, 0.0)  # line_11
    .lineTo(0.2528, 0.0)  # line_12
    .lineTo(0.2528, 0.007)  # line_13
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.007)  # line_14
    .close()  # Close the sketch
)

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.007)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.7500      # X length
W = 0.0778      # Y width
T = 0.0070      # Z thickness

# Middle narrow section dimensions
mid_start = 0.23
mid_end = 0.52
notch_w = 0.02      # small step width in X
step = 0.003        # small step depth in Y

h = W / 2.0         # half width of full section
nh = h - 0.009      # half width of narrow middle section

# Build the stepped outline in the XY plane (matching TOP view)
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, -h)
    .lineTo(mid_start, -h)
    .lineTo(mid_start, -nh + step)
    .lineTo(mid_start + notch_w, -nh)
    .lineTo(mid_end - notch_w, -nh)
    .lineTo(mid_end, -nh + step)
    .lineTo(mid_end, -h)
    .lineTo(L, -h)
    .lineTo(L, h)
    .lineTo(mid_end, h)
    .lineTo(mid_end, nh - step)
    .lineTo(mid_end - notch_w, nh)
    .lineTo(mid_start + notch_w, nh)
    .lineTo(mid_start, nh - step)
    .lineTo(mid_start, h)
    .lineTo(0.0, h)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

import cadquery as cq

# Flat stepped strap: full-width ends, narrower middle section.
# Bounding box: X 0.7500, Y 0.0778, Z 0.0070
L = 0.7500
W = 0.0778
T = 0.0070

x1 = 0.2500
x2 = 0.5000
inner_w = 0.0700
y1 = (W - inner_w) / 2.0
y2 = W - y1

pts = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (x1, 0.0),
    (x1, y1),
    (x2, y1),
    (x2, 0.0),
    (L, 0.0),
    (L, W),
    (x2, W),
    (x2, y2),
    (x1, y2),
    (x1, W),
    (0.0, W),
]

r = cq.Workplane("XY").polyline(pts).close().extrude(T)
